The '''Airam Sector Force''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]], assigned to the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Like most of the other Sector Force, it was created from the support of the local government the [[Airam Clans]]. This Sector Force was known to be able to support respectable fleets and armies from its own resources.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
